sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹5,00,000; other options available per schedule)

room_rent.note: Base policy has no room rent limit. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' can restrict to Single Private AC Room or Twin Sharing Room if opted; ICU remains uncapped even under that optional benefit.

icu.note: No separate restriction on ICU charges; explicitly stated as 'No limit' in base policy and also under Room Rent Modification optional benefit.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base policy. Optional co-payment can be opted for a premium discount (Clause 3.2.7). Smart Select optional benefit adds 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals. True Connect optional benefit adds 10% co-pay for non-emergency direct hospital visits.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure sub-limits found in the base policy wording.

deductible.note: No deductible in base policy. Optional Benefit 'Deductible' (Clause 3.2.6) can be opted for a premium discount; applied on aggregate basis per policy year.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Benefit 'PED Wait Period Modification' can reduce this to a shorter period as per policy schedule. 'Instant Cover' optional benefit waives PED wait for Diabetes/Hypertension/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma from day 31.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailment waiting period of 24 months for listed conditions (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, kidney stones, etc.). Optional Benefit 'Named Ailment Wait Period Modification' can reduce this.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent standard exclusion (Excl18). No inbuilt or optional maternity benefit is offered under this product.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year, capped at 100% of SI. No impact on accrual even if a claim is made. Optional Benefit 'Cumulative Bonus Super' adds an additional 100%/yr up to 500% of SI over and above the base CB.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates up to base SI unlimited times per policy year. Usable for same or different illnesses. Triggered only after base SI + CB + CB Super + Plus Benefit are fully exhausted. Cannot be carried forward.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI

domiciliary.note: Must exceed 3 consecutive days. Excludes 12 listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered at AYUSH hospitals; must be admissible under Hospitalization Expenses benefit.

organ_donor.note: Covers donor's surgical expenses for organ transplant. Post-harvesting expenses of donor not covered.

ambulance.display: Covered up to SI (no separate cap)
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to SI as part of Hospitalization Expenses. Air Ambulance is an optional benefit with a limit specified in the policy schedule.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed advance technology methods covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.) up to SI. Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Optional Benefit 'Claim Shield' (Clause 3.2.17) covers List-I non-medical/consumable items otherwise excluded, up to applicable SI.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl.), infertility/ART, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, refractive error <7.5D, OPD treatment, external prosthetics/devices
optional_riders: Room Rent Modification, PED Wait Reduction, Named Ailment Wait Reduction, Instant Cover (DM/HTN/Asthma/Hyperlipidemia), Deductible, Co-payment, Plus Benefit, Cumulative Bonus Super, Air Ambulance, Claim Shield (consumables), Unlimited Care, Smart Select, True Connect, Women Care, Mental Health Wellbeing, Annual Health Check-up, Be-Fit, Wellness Benefit, New Born Cover, Health Management Program
